title: ReadinessRequirement
description: One entry of the readiness requirement catalog (master plan 9.5, ADR 0037; internal/readiness/catalog). The catalog is derived from what already exists: the integration audit check ids, the application package layout of master plan 9 and the transports of 9.3. Each requirement names the audit check it feeds, so a covered readiness checklist points at what the audit will then verify. A requirement states what the project should contain; it is advisory and describes no certification, authorisation or approval. English and Italian are both mandatory.

schema_version.description: The contract generation of this document.

category.description: What kind of thing the requirement is about.

check_id.description: The integration audit check this requirement feeds. It must name a check registered in internal/integrationaudit; a test enforces it.

level.description: Whether the requirement is mandatory or recommended.

title.description: A short name, in English and Italian.

description.description: What the project should contain and why the audit needs it, in English and Italian.

satisfied_by.description: The finding sources that can cover the requirement: a deterministic rule, a verified model finding, or both. At least one. A model_unverified finding never covers a requirement.

how_satisfied.description: What a rule looks for and, when a verified model finding can also cover it, what evidence that finding must cite, in English and Italian.

remediation.description: What to do when the requirement is missing, partial or contradicted, in English and Italian.
